text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I entered the trainer's office, 
Furioso was there for some reason in her 
racing gear, striking battle-ready poses 
in front of the mirror.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, I was hoping to refocus 
and psych myself up a bit...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Racing silks are garments worn only by 
those competing in GⅠ races. They are 
quite literally the attire one wears while 
carrying the weight of their own dreams.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
And... what I carry on my shoulders isn't 
just my own dream alone.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The hopes of everyone back home—the pride 
of Funabashi. It's truly immense. ...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...This won't do. For me of all people, I 
might have been getting a little 
faint-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing gets you fired up quite like 
training! I look forward to working with 
you again today!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Through her racing silks, Furioso 
seemed to once again feel the weight of 
what she carried on her shoulders—the 
immense pressure.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should come up with some kind of 
secret plan here.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“—Today we're doing a special 
long-distance run around the perimeter 
from here? Bring it on!”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Still... I brought my racing silks as 
instructed, but... is this related to our 
special training as well?
choice_data_list:
You'll understand soon enough. Alright, 
let's head out!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? This path... If I remember right, 
if I keep going this way...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I-I knew it...! Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Ooh, here she comes! Furioso-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: !? Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, Senpai! We all gathered 
'cause Trainer got in touch with us!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
We held your send-off party right here 
when you transferred to the JRA, Senpai. 
Hehe, it feels like it happened ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "...That's right. How nostalgic."

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior C
text_block_list.text:
B-By the way... you brought your racewear, 
right?! Could you show it to me?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. I have one, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then! Since we're here! 
Why don't we run together after this, like 
old times! In your racing outfit too!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, right now? U-Umm...
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what it looks like to 
carry our dreams on our backs!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“...... That's right. Let's show everyone 
what we accomplished over there!”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Senpai is amazing! Just as I 
thought—no! You've gotten so much stronger 
than before...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your racing outfit is so cool 
too! You look totally stunning when you 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I... I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior C
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai. Actually... as your junior, 
there's something I'd like to ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
For the senpai fighting over there... I 
want to infuse your racing silks with it. 
Everyone's wishes—or maybe, our fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Yes—Funabashi power!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
"Go go Senpai! Don't give up, don't lose, 
Senpai! Funabashi isâ"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —The absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I don't know if something like 
this will help, though.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not true. That's not true at 
all. Because I realized something 
important."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"What's woven into this racing attire... 
isn't pressure at all."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That you are the source of my... our 
courage!
choice_data_list:
I'll inject my share of courage into you 
too!
I'll give you my share of courage too!
Our souls will always be right here.
Our souls will always be right here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That you are the source of my... our 
courage!
choice_data_list:
I'll inject my share of courage into you 
too!
I'll give you my share of courage too!
Our souls will always be right here.
Our souls will always be right here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—with renewed determination, she 
returned to the battle in the Central 
League.

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll keep it safe for you forever! 
Whenever you want to reignite that fire, 
please come back anytime!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
